delete_bot.all_off_hint: The delete bot is switched off – nothing is deleted. The patterns can still be edited and tested.
delete_bot.error.invalid: Unusable because they are not valid regular expressions: %{patterns}
delete_bot.invalid_hint: These patterns are not valid regular expressions and therefore never match:
delete_bot.lead: If a chat message matches one of the patterns, it is deleted.
delete_bot.list_hint: One pattern per line. Each is a regular expression without delimiters – case does not matter.
delete_bot.name: Delete bot
delete_bot.perm.test: may test messages against the patterns.
delete_bot.perm.toggle: may switch the delete bot on and off.
delete_bot.result.empty_list: No pattern has been saved yet.
delete_bot.result.owner_note: Twitch does not let anyone delete your own messages as the channel owner – not even when a pattern matches.
delete_bot.result.skipped: %{count} patterns were skipped because they are not a valid regular expression.
delete_bot.result.while_off: The delete bot is switched off – nothing happens in chat right now.
delete_bot.test_hint: Type a message and see whether it would be deleted. The same rules as in operation are used – nothing is deleted here.
delete_bot.toggle_hint: Switch the delete bot on or off. The pattern list is kept.
